Slope equals rise over run; the denominator cannot be zero.
m is the slope and b is the y-intercept.
Solves ax^2+bx+c=0. The expression under the radical is the discriminant.
The x-coordinate of the vertex of y = ax^2 + bx + c (also the axis of symmetry).
Factors any difference of two perfect squares.
Recognise these to factor quickly without expanding.
Add exponents when multiplying like bases, subtract when dividing, multiply when raising a power to a power.
A positive result is an increase; a negative result is a decrease.
a is the initial amount, r the rate per period, t the number of periods.
P principal, r annual rate, n compounds per year, t years.
Distance equals rate multiplied by time; rearrange for the unknown.
Use sum = mean x count to find a missing value.
For a right triangle, c is the hypotenuse.
Sides are in a fixed ratio, so one known side gives the others.
Area uses the square of the radius; circumference is the full distance around.
